messages.author: 65ee6740f5492ac2
messages.subject: genetic map construction with BCsFt
parts:
Dear Karl Broman, dear R/qtl users

I recently started working on GBS data and would like to construct a genetic map from an F7 population and a F2 population of 3 species (F7: species1 x species2  ;  F2: species1 x species3). 
As i have a draft genome of species1, i used it to construct the markers. 

I am using the 'Genetic map consturciton with R/qtl'-script, which is very helpful. 
Still i have some general questions about how to start the genetic map as which markers to include for the inital building of a map. 
Should i be very stringent for the markers to fit the expected allel frequencies (chisquare-test)? Can i include markers with missing data? 
If i allow for no missing-data markers, about 50 % of the markers collaps if i remove duplicates, meaning they are clustering together w/o recombination events.   

Because i think that valuable markers (showing recombination) would be missed for the genetic map building, 
i started including also markers with up to 20 % of missing data into the inital map building. 

Could you tell me what decisions one should make when creating a genetic map from scratch and which markers to include?

As the default setting in R/qtl is an F2 cross, i expect no problems in generating the map for the F2 population. 
After creating the assumed number of linkage groups with fromLinkageGroups(), I first applied the orderMarkers() function and afterwards started to switch markers manually, if they looked odd in the RF plot. 

Whereas for the F7, i used the option in read.cross() F.gen=7. 
I ran the est.map() function and got an inital map. 
Now i would like to order the markers as i did with the F2 population using first automatic ordering and do manual ordering afterwards. 
But i ran into following error:

RIL7lg <- orderMarkers(RIL7lg, chr = 7, use.ripple = FALSE, map.function = "haldane", verbose = TRUE)
Error in countXO(cross, 1) : ripple not available for cross bcsft

Is there another way to create a first automatic ordering of the markers in a chromosome? 

Also the function plotGeno seems not to be working for bcsft-crosses.

plotGeno(RIL7lg)
Error in locateXO(cross) : 
  locateXO only working for backcross, intercross or RI strains.
In addition: Warning message:
In plotGeno(RIL7lg) : First running calc.errorlod.

Thank you very much, 

Michel

parts: Responding to some of your other questions...

> Should i be very stringent for the markers to fit the expected allel frequencies (chisquare-test)?
> Can i include markers with missing data?
In both of these cases, I would omit the marker if I thought it was error-prone. But if the distorted allele frequencies are real and not just genotyping error, I would include the marker.
> Could you tell me what decisions one should make when creating a genetic map from scratch and which markers to include?

General questions like this are very hard to answer.

karl
